findings.issue: The negative point twist ends up split between `Holomorphic/NegPointTwist.lean` and the new `Holomorphic/PointTwist/Negative.lean`, and the new file neither imports nor reuses the existing one: two homes for one subject.

summary: The PR opens a second home for the negative point twist (`PointTwist/Negative.lean`) without importing the existing one (`Holomorphic/NegPointTwist.lean`), duplicating its chart lemma and leaving the continuity and zero-set lemmas away from their siblings. Consolidate the negative-twist basics in one module and put only the Euler-number material in the new file.
